name: Sandstorm
description: A raging wind is blowing sand all over. You can barely open your eyes, it's hard to breath and little sharp rocks pierce your skin.
effect:
- Deal 1 damage to all non-Rock, Ground or Steel Type Pokemon in the field at the end of the round.
- Rock-Type and Ground-Type moves gain +1 flat damage.
- Characters unaffected by Sandstorm Damage gain +2 to their Initiative.
